//: Every setting that decides a render's pixels. render_solid.py applies these explicitly (env vars may override per job). An output's content hash (run.ts) is built from referenceRenderer, the resolved settings below (sampling, denoise, cycles, colour, output, scene, passes -- not device, not comments) and the input textures' bytes; never from source code. The cycles block equals Blender 4.5.14's factory defaults, read from Blender (not guessed).

referenceRenderer.//: Bump revision when a renderer change can alter pixels: every output re-renders. run.ts refuses any other Blender version.
referenceRenderer.name: modbench render_solid

sourceFingerprint.//: sha256 (LF-normalised) of the code that decides pixels. NOT hashed into outputs. lib/render/__tests__/render-config.test.ts fails when the code changes: decide whether pixels can change (bump referenceRenderer.revision) or not (only update this), so editing e.g. device selection never silently re-renders -- nor silently keeps stale renders. render_device.py is deliberately excluded.

device.//: auto tries OPTIX, CUDA, METAL, HIP, ONEAPI in order, then CPU. RENDER_DEVICE=<name> forces one and fails if it is missing. Not in the hash: devices differ only in noise, not in what is drawn.

passes.//: Grey levels the two surface-pass renders use (pack-passes.ts GREYS).
